high_level_description: This image is a movie poster for the film "Late Night with the Devil." The poster has a dark background with a copper-colored border, giving it a vintage feel reminiscent of classic horror or thriller posters from the 1970s. The title "Late Night with the Devil" is prominently displayed in large, bold white letters at the top left corner of the poster. Below the title, there is a tagline that reads: "The live television event that shocked a nation!" This suggests that the film is based on a real-life event involving a live television broadcast.
